items.name: audio-device-select
items.title: Audio Device Select
items.description: A microphone, speaker or source picker with loading, permission, None and disconnected-device states, and a slot for a live preview.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A composable audio player: transport, seek bar with buffering, time, volume, playback rate, loop and keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: bar-visualizer
items.title: Bar Visualizer
items.description: A row of bars driven by frequency bands, with idle, loading and mirrored modes. Bars paint without re-rendering React.

items.name: channel-strip
items.title: Channel Strip
items.description: One channel of a mixer: header, status, meter, fader, value, controls and a notice, as a row or a console strip. The master strip is a variant.

items.name: channel-toggle
items.title: Channel Toggle
items.description: Mute, solo and monitor toggle buttons with their own pressed colours.

items.name: clip-indicator
items.title: Clip Indicator
items.description: A clip light that holds after the signal clips, with an optional count and click to reset.

items.name: db-readout
items.title: dB Readout
items.description: A numeric level label that updates at a readable rate, with a reserved width so the layout never shifts.

items.name: db-scale
items.title: dB Scale
items.description: Tick marks and labels for a decibel range, shared by meters and faders.

items.name: electric-bar-visualizer
items.title: Electric Bar Visualizer
items.description: Frequency-band bars drawn as crackling filaments, with arcs between loud neighbours and sparks on sudden rises. Takes its colour from the theme.

items.name: electric-waveform
items.title: Electric Waveform
items.description: One electric line across the width: a crackling, white-hot trace with a tall glow, forks off the peaks and sparks. Follows the frequency bands as a smooth wave, or the signal itself like an oscilloscope.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: A volume fader in decibels: linear or console taper, detents, a scale, reset, an editable value, silence at the bottom, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A rotary control drawn in SVG, with vertical, horizontal or circular dragging, fine adjustment, reset, a bipolar origin, an optional click sound and a volume dial skin with a numbered scale and an aluminium cap, and a mini aluminium cap for small knobs.

items.name: lcd-display
items.title: LCD Display
items.description: A dot-matrix screen in a bezel, backlit in the light theme and glowing in the dark one: rows of dim labels and bright values in the theme colour or amber, green, cyan or red, dotted separators, a blinking status pixel and dropdown values built on Base UI's Select.

items.name: level-meter
items.title: Level Meter
items.description: A peak and RMS level meter: mono or stereo, horizontal or vertical, solid, segmented or gradient, with zones, peak hold, a scale, a readout and a clip light.

items.name: live-waveform
items.title: Live Waveform
items.description: A canvas waveform of a live signal: scrolling level history or the current frame, as bars, a mirrored shape or a line.

items.name: mic-setup
items.title: Microphone Setup
items.description: Choose and check a microphone: device select with a live preview, a level meter, gain, mute and a level check that says whether you sound right.

items.name: mixer
items.title: Mixer
items.description: The container for channel strips: shared meter settings, keyboard navigation between strips, a master area and an empty state.

items.name: music-player
items.title: Music Player
items.description: A playlist player with a waveform seek bar, shuffle, repeat, volume and optional ducking under the microphone.

items.name: pan-control
items.title: Pan Control
items.description: Left and right balance with a fill from the centre, a centre detent and reset.

items.name: parameter-slider
items.title: Parameter Slider
items.description: A labelled slider with a numeric input, unit, marks, reset and a linear or log scale, for gain trims, delays, thresholds and frequencies.

items.name: quick-audio-popover
items.title: Quick Audio Popover
items.description: Compact microphone and system audio controls behind one toolbar button that shows a live level.

items.name: smooth-waveform
items.title: Smooth Waveform
items.description: One clean line across the width that follows the sound, as a smooth wave shaped by the frequency bands or a triggered oscilloscope trace.

items.name: sound-pad
items.title: Sound Pad
items.description: A trigger pad with one-shot, toggle, hold and loop modes, a hotkey, playback progress and an accent colour, plus a grid with hotkeys and arrow navigation.

items.name: soundboard
items.title: Soundboard
items.description: A grid of sound pads with global hotkeys, per-pad mode and volume in a context menu, master volume, stop all, and drag-and-drop to add sounds.

items.name: spectrum
items.title: Spectrum
items.description: A frequency spectrum analyser drawn on canvas as bars, a line or an area, with peak hold, a grid and frequency and level axes.

items.name: system-audio-mixer
items.title: System Audio Mixer
items.description: The complete mixer: microphone, system audio, music and sound pads with meters, faders, mute, solo, monitor and ducking, a limited master and a mixed output stream, all running on Web Audio.

items.name: system-audio-settings
items.title: System Audio Settings
items.description: Turn system audio capture on, set its level, watch its meter and explain what the browser will capture.

items.name: track-list
items.title: Track List
items.description: A list of tracks with active and playing states, arrow-key navigation and slots for artwork, duration and actions.

items.name: volume-control
items.title: Volume Control
items.description: A 0..1 volume slider with a mute button and a perceptual curve, for players.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: A static waveform of a clip with a smooth playhead, seeking by pointer and keyboard, hover time, draggable regions and markers.
